issue.title: bob randomize: bulk re-roll of due prioritized tasks
issue.description: `bob randomize` re-rolls every due P1–P4 Obsidian task to its own random date inside that task's configured priority window. Each touched note is written once, with the new date, Blocked status, a 🎲 Schedule Log entry, and status grouping applied together. The result is published as exactly one scoped `bob randomize` commit, taken between two vault-sync cycles under the shared maintenance lock. The command also has a reproducible dry-run preview, polished human output, and a stable JSON contract.
